slides.headline: Top 6 AI Skills
content: Prompt Systems: Design multi-agent workflows instructions for reliable outputs. (Tools: CrewAI, AutoGen)
AI Governance: Audit AI systems for compliance (EU AI Act) and ethics. (Tools: OneTrust, Credo AI)
Collaboration: Augment human judgment with AI verification skills. (Tools: Human-in-the-loop)
RAG Systems: Structure data for accurate AI retrieval and knowledge management. (Tools: NotebookLM, Pinecone)
Agentic Design: Architect autonomous agent hierarchies without coding. (Tools: Zapier, Make)
Strategic EI: Focus on empathy, negotiation, and high-level vision. (Tools: Your Brain)
